name: ffrwd/moq
description: Media over QUIC in both directions, hosted in wasm: publish a query's streams TO a relay broadcast, and subscribe to one as a FROM relation. Publishing packages each encoded stream as fragmented MP4 - one fragment per group of pictures, a hang catalog naming the renditions with their init segments - so a hang player picks a rendition and plays it. Subscribing reads that catalog back as rows, one per rendition, and demuxes each fragment to the packets it was built from, so a rung crosses the graph encoded. Both in one query is a relay.
